goal: Meet S1 of docs/specs/drive-always-lanes.spec.md: on both Hosts, start_unattended_batch accepts a task_id and turns one standalone validated TaskIntent into a one-child Lane batch (plan_source single_task, slug = task_id, max_parallel 1) authorized by exactly one native gate, with the Lane child enrolled through deriveChildEnrollment, its state visible through status, and its settled delivery integrated onto imm/<task_id> by the existing merge queue (Spec D1, D2).

acceptance.assertion: On Claude Code and Pi, a literal drive entry calling start_unattended_batch with task_id for a validated, enrollment-ready TaskIntent opens exactly one native gate bound to the TaskIntent revision, content hash and preparation digest, records a v2 Lane batch with plan_source single_task, slug equal to task_id and max_parallel 1, creates the Lane at imm/worktrees/<task_id>/<task_id> on imm-lane/<task_id>/<task_id> at the current HEAD, copies an uncommitted TaskIntent into it, and enrolls the child in the Lane store through deriveChildEnrollment without opening a second gate (BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-5). Each of these refuses before any gate opens and creates no Lane: both initiative_slug and task_id (batch_entry_ambiguous), neither, a task_id whose TaskIntent is invalid or not enrollment_ready, a task_id that is a child of an active Initiative batch, and a task_id entry that meets an existing Initiative record or an Initiative entry that meets a single_task record (batch_entry_kind_mismatch). Initiative batches keep their current behavior. Seam: the Host entry with a counting native-gate stub in the named test files.

On both Hosts, status queried with the task_id of a single-task Lane batch returns that record in batch.record with its plan_source, batch_state and the child's Lane state and path, the same fields a batch child shows (BR-REQ-5); status for a task_id with no batch and no TaskRecord returns no batch record. Seam: the status read in the named test files.

When the single-task Lane child settles done, the runner commits the settled delivery and its .imm/audit pair on the Lane branch and fast-forwards imm/<task_id> to a candidate whose changed paths and per-path content equal that commit; a candidate that does not match moves no ref and parks the child needs_human with the existing integration reason, never integrating part of the delivery (BR-REQ-4). Seam: tests/single-task-lane-batch.test.ts with a settled Lane fixture.
